title: At the Frozen Gate
text: A crumbling gate looms out of the white. Wind scours your face. The wood is rimed with ice.

0.resultText: You slam into the gate and bounce off; pain blossoms in your shoulder.

1.resultText: The gate shifts with a groan, but the ice holds.

2.resultText: With a final heave, the bar splinters and the gate yawns inward.

0.resultText: Your fingers numb; you slip back to the snow.

1.resultText: You find purchase and haul yourself over the top.

title: Bruised Knuckles
text: The gate defies you. Breath plumes; your arms tremble.

choices.text: Catch your breath and go around

title: Hidden Trail
text: Beyond the wall, a narrow track threads north, half-buried by drifting snow.

0.resultText: The trail blurs, swallowed by new snowfall.

1.resultText: You keep to the firmer ground and skirt a shallow hollow.

title: Snowblind Ambush
text: Figures burst from the brush—ragged furs, crude blades. A trap.

0.resultText: A club catches your ribs. You go down hard.

1.resultText: You twist away, taking a glancing blow as you break free.

2.resultText: You read the lunge early and slip past cleanly.

0.resultText: Your shout falters; they dogpile you.

1.resultText: You scatter the closest two, but more close in.

2.resultText: Your fury breaks their nerve; the path opens.

title: Blood on Snow
text: You stagger free, cuts stinging in the cold.

title: Rope and Rough Hands
text: They bind your wrists and drag you toward a smoking camp.

0.resultText: Your words freeze in your mouth; they jeer.

1.resultText: A few waver; the leader shakes his head.

2.resultText: They untie you warily and shove you out into the dark.

title: Crude Pen
text: A lash of rawhide bites your wrist. The pen reeks of smoke and wet fur.

choices.text: Pick the knot and slip out

0.resultText: The lash tightens; a guard turns.

1.resultText: You wriggle free but jostle a post—someone stirs.

2.resultText: Quiet as breath, you ghost into the trees.

title: Torn Wrist
text: Blood trickles warm under the bindings. You run anyway.

title: Moonlit Clearing
text: Frosted grass glows under a thin moon. A cave mouth yawns in a rocky shelf.

title: Hushed Halls
text: Inside the ruins, glyphs coil across damp stone. Something listens.

0.resultText: The symbols writhe; your head throbs.

1.resultText: Fragments resolve—warnings of a bound thing.

2.resultText: Meaning locks into place; a path reveals itself.

title: The Fissure
text: A narrow cleft breathes cold air from deep within.

0.resultText: You wedge fast; rock scrapes your ribs.

2.resultText: You flow through the gap like smoke.

title: Stuck
text: The gap narrows to a cruel pinch. You back out, bruised.

title: Bone-Cold Dark
text: Pale crystals dust the floor. A low altar glimmers ahead.

0-1.resultText: Whispers slither away from sense. A chill lingers.

2+.resultText: Words kindle in your mind; something answers.

title: A Door of Runes
text: The glyphs align in your thoughts, sketching out a path to a sealed door.

*.resultText: The runes flare and the door thunders open.

title: Something Old Stirs
text: A slow pulse hums through stone and bone. You are seen.

title: Back to the Fire
text: You find your way back to familiar ground. The world waits.
